papers.title: Criticality on Rényi Defects at ( 2 + 1 ) D O(3) Quantum Critical Points
papers.read_extent: main results/discussion pp2-5 and captions Figs1-4; introduction not reread
observations: Cut geometry defines defect observables. Correlation plus Binder cumulant discriminate disordered and ordered regimes; power law with correction term is used for decaying correlations, polynomial-in-1/L extrapolation for putative finite intercepts. Near-critical n=4 correlator and squared magnetization intercept discrepancy exposes remaining finite-size corrections; n=10 agreement is stronger. Size-cutoff stability and another lattice model provide distinct controls.
limitations: Authors acknowledge apparent order could be finite-size manifestation of very small scaling dimension. Do not convert Binder crossings or finite intercept fits into unconditional thermodynamic proof; sampled Renyi indices and finite L must remain visible.
papers.layout_observation: Single-column rows/columns align observable versus Renyi condition; separate Binder versus n panels reuse size colors. Compact axis labels approach crowding.
